tools.name: list_folder
tools.rich: Names and kinds (file or folder) of the items directly inside one folder, nothing deeper. Not for finding a file whose folder is unknown and not for the size or dates of a single item.

params.name: path
params.rich: The folder to list, written as a path.

params.name: sort_by
params.rich: How to order the items: name, modified (newest first) or size (largest first). By name when omitted.

tools.name: search_files
tools.rich: Files and folders whose name contains the search text, from anywhere in the drive or from inside one folder. Not for listing everything in a folder and not for looking inside the contents of files.

params.name: query
params.rich: Part of the name to look for.

params.name: folder
params.rich: Limit the search to this folder and everything under it, written as a path. The whole drive when omitted.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.rich: Size, type, owner, creation date and last-modified date for one file or folder. Not for what is inside a folder and not for earlier versions of a file.

params.name: path
params.rich: The file or folder, written as a path.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.rich: Make a new empty folder; the folder it goes in must already exist. Not for saving files and not for duplicating a folder that already exists.

params.name: path
params.rich: Where the new folder goes, written as a path that ends with its name.

tools.name: move_file
tools.rich: Take one file or folder out of its current folder and put it in another, keeping its name and contents; it is gone from the old place afterwards. Not for leaving a duplicate behind and not for changing the name.

params.name: source_path
params.rich: The file or folder to move, written as a path.

params.name: destination_folder
params.rich: The folder it should end up in, written as a path.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.rich: Make a duplicate of one file inside a folder and leave the original where it is. Not for relocating the original and not for changing a name.

params.name: source_path
params.rich: The file to duplicate, written as a path.

params.name: destination_folder
params.rich: The folder the duplicate goes in, written as a path.

params.name: new_name
params.rich: Name for the duplicate. The original name when omitted.

tools.name: rename_file
tools.rich: Change the name of one file or folder where it sits. Not for putting it in a different folder.

params.name: path
params.rich: The file or folder to rename, written as a path.

params.name: new_name
params.rich: The new name on its own, with no folders in front of it.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.rich: Send one file or folder to the trash, from where it can be brought back for a while. Not for erasing anything for good.

params.name: path
params.rich: The file or folder, written as a path.

tools.name: restore_from_trash
tools.rich: Bring one trashed item back to the folder it was deleted from. Not for older versions of a file that is still in place.

params.name: file_name
params.rich: The name of the item in the trash, with its extension.

tools.name: list_trash
tools.rich: The items currently in the trash, newest deletion first, with the date each was deleted and the folder it came from. Not for how long items are kept.

params.name: limit
params.rich: How many items to show, 1 to 50.

tools.name: share_file
tools.rich: Give one named person access to a file or folder at the level chosen; they are told by email. Not for making a link that anyone can open.

params.name: path
params.rich: The file or folder to share, written as a path.

params.name: email
params.rich: Email address of the person who gets access.

params.name: permission
params.rich: What the person may do: viewer (look only), commenter (look and leave comments) or editor (change it).

tools.name: get_share_link
tools.rich: A web link that anyone who has it can open to see one file or folder, optionally set to stop working after some days. Not for giving access to a named person.

params.name: path
params.rich: The file or folder to link to, written as a path.

params.name: expires_in_days
params.rich: Days until the link stops working, 1 to 90. It never expires when omitted.

tools.name: save_from_url
tools.rich: Download the file at a web address and store it in a folder of the drive. Not for copying a file that is already in the drive.

params.name: url
params.rich: The full address of the file, starting with https://.

params.name: destination_folder
params.rich: The folder the file should be stored in, written as a path.

params.name: if_exists
params.rich: What to do when that folder already holds a file with the same name: replace it, keep_both, or skip the download.

tools.name: check_storage_usage
tools.rich: How much of the storage allowance is used and how much is free, for the whole drive. Not for the size of one file.

params.name: unit
params.rich: Size unit for all the figures, in binary multiples of a byte.

tools.name: list_recent_files
tools.rich: Files added or changed lately, newest first, from anywhere in the drive. Not for searching by name and not for the contents of one folder.

params.name: days
params.rich: How far back to look, 1 to 30 days.

params.name: kind
params.rich: Only files of this kind: document, image, video, audio or other. All kinds when omitted.

tools.name: list_file_versions
tools.rich: Earlier versions of one file: version number, date saved and who saved it. Not for bringing back a file that was deleted.

params.name: path
params.rich: The file or folder, written as a path.

params.name: limit
params.rich: How many versions to show, 1 to 50. The latest 10 when omitted.

tools.name: get_retention_period
tools.rich: How long the drive keeps items of one kind before they are erased permanently. Not for what is in the trash right now.

params.name: item_type
params.rich: Which kind of item: trash (deleted files), versions (earlier versions of files) or share_links (links to files).
